model_organism.citation: Vagal stimulation ameliorates murine colitis by regulating SUMOylation (PMID: 39565873)
phenotypes: Sumo3-KO: protected against development of colitis and delayed onset of disease
Sumo1-KO: halted progression of colitis
Sumo1-KO bone marrow transplants into wild-type mice conferred protection against colitis development
Electric vagal stimulation delayed colitis onset in Sumo1-KO mice and resulted in milder symptoms in Sumo3-KO mice

model_organism.citation: Bone marrow stromal cells protect myeloma cells from ferroptosis through GPX4 deSUMOylation (PMID: 39653239)
phenotypes: Sumo2 knockout (SUMO2-KO) mice: reduced ferroptosis in MM cells
SUMO2-KO mice showed altered GPX4 protein stability and ROS metabolism
Reduced tumor burden in SUMO2-KO mice bearing MM tumors
Prolonged survival of SUMO2-KO mice with MM tumors
Alleviated bone disruption in SUMO2-KO mice bearing MM tumors

model_organism.citation: β-catenin-inhibited Sumoylation modification of LKB1 and fatty acid metabolism is critical in renal fibrosis (PMID: 39438470)
phenotypes: Conditional knockout of β-catenin in tubular cells preserved fatty acid oxidation
Blocked lipid accumulation by maintaining LKB1 Sumoylation and AMPK activation
Ectopic expression of Sumo3 (not Sumo1 or Sumo2) inhibited Wnt1-aggravated lipid accumulation and fibrogenesis in unilateral ischemia-reperfusion mice
Sumo3 overexpression retarded lipid accumulation and fibrogenesis in the kidney

model_organism.citation: Genetic and pharmacologic enhancement of SUMO2 conjugation prevents and reverses cognitive impairment and synaptotoxicity in a preclinical model of Alzheimer's disease (PMID: 40047257)
phenotypes: Elevated SUMO2 expression prevents cognitive impairment in APP transgenic mice
Elevated SUMO2 expression prevents synaptic impairment in APP transgenic mice
SUMO2 overexpression prevents long-term potentiation (LTP) impairments in APP transgenics
SUMO2 overexpression prevents cognitive deficits in APP transgenics without affecting amyloid pathology
SBT02 (SUMO2 analogue) prophylactically halted progression of AD-associated deficits
SBT02 restored cognition and synaptic function in late-stage amyloid load
SBT02 reversed pre-existing LTP and cognitive impairments in advanced pathology

model_organism.citation: Myeloid SENP3 deficiency protects mice from diet and age-induced obesity via regulation of YAP1 SUMOylation (PMID: 38070059)
phenotypes: Senp3flox/flox;Lyz2-Cre mice show lower body weight gain after HFD challenge
Reduced adiposity in Senp3flox/flox;Lyz2-Cre mice after HFD
Reduced adipocyte size in Senp3flox/flox;Lyz2-Cre mice after HFD
Reduced adipocyte size in Senp3flox/flox;Lyz2-Cre mice during aging
Attenuated macrophage infiltration in adipose tissue during diet and age-induced obesity
Reduced serum levels of inflammatory factors during diet and age-induced obesity
Reduced YAP1 protein level in adipose tissue during obesity

model_organism.citation: SUMOylation of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein is a key target for broad-spectrum antiviral therapy (PMID: 40521184)
phenotypes: SUMO1 knockout increases Spike trimer formation and co-localization with SUMO2 at perinuclear puncta
SUMO1 knockout facilitates virion particle release
SUMO2 knockout leads to enhanced Spike cleavage
SUMO2 knockout promotes viral cell-to-cell transmission
cpSIM2 peptide exhibits robust inhibitory activity against SARS-CoV-2 variants in hACE2-transgenic mice

biological.citation: TRIM28 SUMOylates and stabilizes NLRP3 to facilitate inflammasome activation (PMID: 34373456)
biological.summary: SUMO2 is conjugated to NLRP3 by the E3 SUMO ligase TRIM28, promoting SUMO1, SUMO2, and SUMO3 modification of NLRP3 which inhibits ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation, thereby stabilizing NLRP3 and facilitating inflammasome activation.

biological.citation: Vagal stimulation ameliorates murine colitis by regulating SUMOylation (PMID: 39565873)
biological.summary: SUMO2 and SUMO3 levels are increased in colonic biopsies from IBD patients and mouse models during active disease; genetic deletion of Sumo3 protected against colitis development and delayed disease onset in mouse models, while TAK-981 (SUMO-activating enzyme inhibitor) ameliorated disease in three murine IBD models.
biological.sample_size: Mouse models of colitis; human IBD patient biopsies

biological.citation: Ferroptosis-induced SUMO2 lactylation counteracts ferroptosis by enhancing ACSL4 degradation in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 41057295)
biological.summary: SUMO2-K11 lactylation (SUMO2-K11la) is the most prominently elevated lactylation in response to ferroptosis induction in LUAD cells; SUMO2-K11la impairs SUMO2-ACSL4 interaction, facilitating ACSL4 degradation and conferring ferroptosis resistance. AARS1 is identified as the lactyltransferase and HDAC1 as the delactylase for SUMO2-K11la.
biological.sample_size: LUAD cell lines; xenograft and spontaneous lung cancer models

biological.citation: DHX9 SUMOylation is required for the suppression of R-loop-associated genome instability (PMID: 39019926)
biological.summary: SUMO2 fusion to DHX9 K120R mutant enhances association with R-loop-associated proteins (PARP1, DDX21) via SUMO-interacting motifs, reduces R-loop accumulation, and alleviates survival defects, demonstrating SUMO2's role in facilitating protein interactions critical for genome stability.

biological.citation: Astragaloside IV combined with ligustrazine ameliorates abnormal mitochondrial dynamics via Drp1 SUMO/deSUMOylation in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (PMID: 38615367)
biological.summary: SUMO2/3 binding to Drp1 suppresses mitochondrial fission and promotes mitochondrial fusion; SUMO2/3 overexpression suppressed mitochondrial fission while SUMO1 overexpression promoted it. Treatment with AST IV and ligustrazine increased Drp1-SUMO2/3 binding and enhanced protective effects against ischemia-reperfusion injury in rat CIRI models and SH-SY5Y cells.
biological.sample_size: Rat CIRI models; SH-SY5Y neuronal cells

biological.citation: Paralogue-Specific Roles of SUMO1 and SUMO2/3 in Protein Quality Control and Associated Diseases (PMID: 38201212)
biological.summary: SUMO2/3 paralogues play a critical role in proteostasis by converging with ubiquitylation to mediate protein degradation primarily through SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligases (STUbLs), which preferentially bind and ubiquitylate poly-SUMO2/3 modified proteins. SUMO2/3 are implicated in multiple human diseases associated with disturbed proteostasis.

biological.citation: LncRNA INHEG promotes glioma stem cell maintenance and tumorigenicity through regulating rRNA 2'-O-methylation (PMID: 37980347)
biological.summary: SUMO2 E3 ligase TAF15 mediates SUMO2 modification of NOP58 (a core snoRNP component); INHEG induces TAF15-NOP58 interaction to regulate NOP58 sumoylation and accelerate C/D box snoRNP assembly, enhancing rRNA 2'-O-methylation and oncogenic protein expression in glioma stem cells.

biological.citation: SUMOylation-Driven mRNA Circularization Enhances Translation and Promotes Lymphatic Metastasis of Bladder Cancer (PMID: 37991737)
biological.summary: DHCR24 recognizes SUMO2 modification at lysine 108 of hnRNPA2B1 to foster TBK1 mRNA circularization and eIF4F initiation complex assembly by enhancing hnRNPA2B1-eIF4G1 interaction, promoting lymphangiogenesis and lymph node metastasis in bladder cancer.

biological.citation: Dynamic SUMOylation of MORC2 orchestrates chromatin remodelling and DNA repair in response to DNA damage and drives chemoresistance in breast cancer (PMID: 36793866)
biological.summary: MORC2 is modified by SUMO2/3 at lysine 767 in a SUMO-interacting motif dependent manner; MORC2 SUMOylation is dynamically regulated during DNA damage response, with deSUMOylation enabling transient chromatin relaxation for DNA repair and re-SUMOylation promoting DNA-PKcs phosphorylation. SUMOylation-deficient MORC2 or SUMO inhibitors enhance breast cancer cell sensitivity to chemotherapeutic drugs.
biological.sample_size: Breast cancer cell lines; in vivo xenograft models

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - Maternally Inherited novel SUMO2 variant associated with a complex phenotype (D. Otohinoyi, C. Hicks, R. Zambrano)
biological.summary: A novel heterozygous SUMO2 start codon variant (c.2 T>A: p.Met1?) identified in a family with complex developmental phenotype including skeletal abnormalities, syndactyly, and cardiac defects. In silico analysis and animal studies showing SUMO2 knockdown alters expression of embryonic development genes (CDX2, OCT4, NANOG) and results in embryonic lethality suggest this variant is pathogenic.
